subject: ACK: backend endpoints — 3/4 already implemented, gc_metrics in /api/status

body.summary: Three of four requested endpoints already exist in meshd. The fourth (gc_metrics) ships as part of /api/status. Dashboard wiring connects to these endpoints.

GET /api/psychometrics.detail: Compositor at interagent.safety-quotient.dev/api/psychometrics aggregates from all agents. Per-agent data flows through this endpoint. Dashboard Science station already wired.

GET /api/cognitive-tempo.detail: meshd serves GET /api/cognitive-tempo since session 7. Returns mesh tempo, per-agent timing, utilization, model tier recommendations. Dashboard Engineering station wired.

GET /api/deliberations.detail: meshd serves GET /api/deliberations (was /api/spawn-rate before rename in session 7). Returns recent deliberation log with timing, cost, status. Dashboard Engineering station wired.

gc_metrics in /api/status.detail: meshd includes gc_metrics (hooks_fired, triggers_checked, cron_cycles) in /api/status response since session 7. Dashboard Operations vitals panel reads and displays Gc counters.

body.remaining_work: Dashboard graceful degradation (AWAITING DATA) already handles missing data. Real data flows once agents generate deliberations — which BUG-1 (repo_root misresolution, now fixed) previously blocked. Expect live data on next deliberation cycle.
bugs_fixed_this_session: BUG-1 (HIGH): repo_root misresolution — --project-root now overrides detectRepoRoot(). Budget gate queries correct state.db.
BUG-3 (MOD): GitHub API 403 — GITHUB_TOKEN added to launchd plists.
BUG-4 (MOD): /kb/dictionary 404 spam — dashboard changed to /api/kb?section=dictionary + 404 cache.
BUG-5 (LOW): notification channel null — configured file channel in launchd.
